name: Lakehills Plaza
summary: Lakehills Plaza is a 75,914 square foot urban neighborhood retail center located three miles south of downtown Austin at the high-traffic intersection of Lamar Boulevard and Highway 290. Shadow anchored by a top-performing Target, the center features a curated mix of health, wellness, and dining tenants serving the affluent South Austin community.
demographics: Lakehills Plaza serves an affluent urban Austin market with a 3-mile trade area population of 116,059 and median household income of $98,295. The center attracts a diverse mix of young professionals and families, with the 1-mile radius showing a median household income of $84,122 and per capita income of $64,950. The daytime population swells to 164,007 within 3 miles, indicating strong employment centers nearby. The trade area demographics reflect Austin's educated, health-conscious urban residents who value convenience and quality lifestyle amenities.
description: Lakehills Plaza is a premier urban neighborhood retail center strategically positioned at one of Austin's most accessible intersections, the heavily trafficked Lamar Boulevard and Highway 290 corridor. Located just three miles south of downtown Austin, this 75,914 square foot shopping destination is shadow anchored by a top-performing Target, providing consistent traffic and visibility to the center's synergistic tenant mix. The property has been thoughtfully curated to serve the surrounding affluent urban community with a focus on health, wellness, and dining establishments that cater to Austin's active lifestyle culture. With a parking ratio of 5.32 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the center offers exceptional convenience for shoppers in this high-density urban market. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, Lakehills Plaza benefits from professional management and a commitment to maintaining a vibrant retail environment that serves the evolving needs of South Austin's dynamic residential and commercial community.
